_doc: The Candy Kingdom frosting ground's woods (bead bzc.115, docs/art/classes/trees.md): cotton-candy and lollipop groves with candy canes. generate-image-v2 at 48 x 48 like set trees (one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject); the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Never scaled, never mirrored. Layers: style, light, class-tree, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one small candy tree, chunky and cute, each image a different one of these: a cotton-candy tree with a big fluffy round crown of pink spun sugar #f08cb8 (shadow #c25a8c, light #ffc2dc on the left side) on a short striped stick, a cotton-candy tree with a fluffy mint crown #8fdcc0 (shadow #4fa58a), a giant round swirl lollipop of red and white #e03a3e #fff4ec on a thick white stick, a tree of three stacked fluffy pink cotton-candy puffs. A short candy stick trunk. A full crown about two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.
recipes.negative: face, eyes, person, ground, sand patch, grass, pot, hand, wrapper
